abstraction_design.rationale: The abstractions sit exactly where the app varies (cards-for-refs, sections, sortable move tables, generic named-resource fetching) and stretch to an Items section without copying lib code. The deduction is the duplicated home-list card builder and the accumulating optional Card fields.

findings.issue: Home load builds Card objects inline, duplicating the card-construction logic (id/name/label/sprite, dex ordering) that already exists in cardsFor in lib/server/api.ts; sprite or naming fixes must land in both places.
findings.suggestion: Extend cardsFor (or extract a makeCard(species, extra) helper in api.ts) so all card lists share one construction path; have the home load feed it species IDs plus type slots.

findings.issue: The shared Card type carries `hidden?: boolean`, and CardList renders a 'Hidden ability' span, solely for the Abilities page — page-specific presentation leaking into a shared component.
findings.suggestion: Let CardList accept a per-card footer snippet (or an optional note string prop) instead of a hardcoded ability-specific field.

findings.issue: The load rebuilds the type-labels Map inline instead of calling the existing getTypeLabels() helper in api.ts:157.
findings.suggestion: Use getTypeLabels() so label derivation (and future changes to it) has one home.

findings.issue: Keyed each block key `${row.name}-${row.level}-${i}` includes the loop index, weakening the key and forcing DOM churn on re-sort.
findings.suggestion: Give rows a stable key (e.g. `${row.name}-${row.level}` or precomputed id from the load) instead of the index.

findings.issue: Cache eviction only runs once size exceeds 5000 and only removes already-expired entries, so the cache grows unbounded until that threshold; caching rules are otherwise perfectly centralized.
findings.suggestion: Cap or sweep the Map (e.g. drop oldest/expired on insert) if the data-source scenario ever enlarges the cacheable surface.

summary: A clean, current-idiom SvelteKit 3 app: all API access, caching and env handling are centralized in lib/server/api.ts, components are small typed-prop units, and the URL is the only shared state. The notable editability debt is duplicated card construction between the home load and cardsFor, which splits the sprite/species-mapping fix across two files. Everything else — removing a route, changing the data source, adding a sibling resource — touches a small, grep-findable set of files.
